items.title: Dave Liebman — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Sweet Hands is a real record date in the studio, Abercrombie, Charlie Haden.

ctx.x: How would you compare that to the Sweet Hands date?

No, Sweet Hands is a real record date in the studio, Abercrombie, Charlie Haden. That’s a real record date. This is like an Indian – put-together, just because we were in India. We were the first jazz group in India in 20 years, since Benny Goodman. Something like that. It was quite something, the trip to India. It was really amazing. Of course it was amazing.

There’s a variety of things with – at least the Forgotten Fantasies date we talked about. Then there’s the Lookout Farm date that Mosaic Select put out in recent years, that was done in San Francisco.

items.title: John Abercrombie interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, April 19, 2001
items.q: But I know Dave and I know I got a sense this is probably going to be probably a pretty good one.

ctx.x: You know I don’t know if I can remember. Well I do remember one, and I could, yeah I do remember what I consider probably to be actually one of the worst projects I ever did, maybe the worst, and there were some great people on it, but, and I won’t tell you the name of the person whose record it was because I’ve never heard from him since. I think he just, I think this was his one chance at trying to make a record. I don’t know if he was a tax write-off or if somebody just really liked him and just wanted to give…

had a couple of people I’ve spoken to and said oh yeah, I heard that record, man what a terrible, what a rotten record that is, why did you do that? I only had one answer. I did it for money. Somebody offered me extremely good money to fly me out and do this project and I figured well all these great musicians, it’s got to be good. And it wasn’t, and in a situation like that it wasn’t just that he didn’t sound good, nobody really sounded good. Everything just kind of came down to this base level of just — I mean…
Well I hope those are few and far between for you.
